name: CVE-2026-42880-argocd-server-side-diff-secret-extraction
description: CVE-2026-42880 is a critical vulnerability in Argo CD's ServerSideDiff endpoint that allows an attacker with Argo CD application get permissions to extract plaintext Kubernetes Secret data via the Kubernetes API server's Server-Side Apply dry-run mechanism.
remediation: Upgrade Argo CD to a patched version (v3.2.11+ or v3.3.9+).
test: The control checks for vulnerable versions of Argo CD (v3.2.0 through v3.2.10, and v3.3.0 through v3.3.8).
long_description: CVE-2026-42880 is a critical security flaw in Argo CD with a CVSS v3.1 score of 9.6. A missing authorization and data-masking gap in the ServerSideDiff endpoint causes raw, unmasked PredictedLive and NormalizedLive states to be returned to callers. Argo CD's defense layer (removeWebhookMutation) is bypassed entirely when an Application carries the annotation argocd.argoproj.io/compare-options: IncludeMutationWebhook=true, so plaintext Kubernetes Secret values read from etcd flow directly into the API response. Any user with Argo CD application get permission can extract real Secret values including service account tokens, TLS certificates, database credentials, and API keys. The vulnerability affects argocd-server versions v3.2.0 through v3.3.8 and is patched in v3.2.11 and v3.3.9.
